acceptance: Quota rows reserved by a refused attempt are released so total (lifetime) and day: do not drain
Origin is checked against ALLOWED_ORIGINS (comma-separated; unset means url.origin only)
Markup, control, Bidi, zero-width, separator and lone-surrogate characters are refused before AI; draft stays plain text
Fallback paths log a reason code and error name only; cleanup also purges stale day: rows
Existing 15 worker tests stay green; each review item has a counterexample test that fails on the previous worker

reuse.reason: 既存のreserve/fallback/DELETEを拡張し、レスポンス形とCSPは変更しない
既存のQuotaモックにUPDATEを追加し、反例試験を追記。実SQLはnode:sqliteで実行
quota表の定義を変えずにUPDATE count=MAX(count-1,0)で戻す
draftはtextarea.valueで描画済み。平文契約の根拠として試験で固定し、変更しない
MITの固定バージョンQRライブラリを維持。全体コピー比較からこの既知vendorだけ除外し、秘密検査は免除しない
